name: Confucius4-R2T2

lineage.how_derived: Longest Stable Prefix (LSP) learning on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio, SFT then GRPO; only the language decoder is updated, audio encoder and projector stay frozen (card)

purpose: Low-latency stable-prefix streaming ASR for real real-time transcription: chunks from 80 ms to 2 s, monotonic output that commits text permanently without revising earlier words, for applications that act on the text immediately (card).

license.notes: MODEL_LICENSE read (first 5 of 11k characters in detail): royalty-free limited license; users or affiliates with over 100 million monthly active users or over RMB 1 billion annual revenue must request a separate license that NetEase may grant at its sole discretion; downstream recipients must be bound to the same terms; derivative works (fine-tunes, quantizations, outputs-based models) are covered. Code repository is Apache-2.0. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B (audio encoder plus Qwen3 decoder) with stable-prefix streaming decoding
architecture.why_this_design: Card: LSP learning teaches the decoder which prefix of its hypothesis is stable so that committed text is never revised; chunk size and the number of withheld provisional tokens (U) trade accuracy against emission lag without retraining.

variants.notes: card lists further backends (vLLM; llama.cpp route via the r2t2_llama package with separate audio encoder and decoder modes)

engine_support.notes: Qwen3-ASR architecture, shared with qwen3-asr-1.7b and rumble-2-flash records.

German transfers from English/Chinese post-training: FLEURS 8.05% streaming versus 36.49% for the unmodified base at 160 ms
weaknesses: Post-training was Chinese and English only; German streaming WER (8.05% FLEURS) is about twice the offline base (3.95%)
Vendor-only numbers, comparison rows include API products run by the builder
best_for: live dictation and real-time captions where committed text must not change
soft.maturity: NetEase Youdao; paper arXiv 2611.06043 (not read); 39k downloads on the HF API.

tona_fit.reason: Streaming dictation is a distinct use case from offline ASR and this is the only stable-prefix model seen in the sweep; German works but at a clear cost against offline. Qwen3-ASR backbone shared with other candidates.
blockers: German quality only measured by the builder on FLEURS and MLS
